title: Candle in the Wind
lyrics_synced:
[00:03.97] Goodbye England's Rose
[00:06.93] May you ever grow in our hearts.
[00:10.38] You were the grace that placed itself
[00:13.37] Where lives were torn apart.
[00:18.58] You called out to our country,
[00:22.81] And you whispered to those in pain.
[00:26.26] Now you belong to heaven,
[00:28.74] And the stars spell out your name.
[00:35.22] And it seems to me you lived your life
[00:39.16] like a candle in the wind
[00:43.11] Never fading with the sunset
[00:46.60] when the rain set in.
[00:50.83] And your footsteps will always fall here,
[00:54.54] Along England's greenest hills;
[00:57.50] Your candle burned out long before
[01:01.24] your legend ever will
[01:07.44] Loveliness we've lost;
[01:10.40] These empty days without your smile.
[01:13.85] This torch we'll always carry
[01:16.11] For our nation's golden child.
[01:22.06] And even though we try,
[01:26.28] The truth brings us to tears;
[01:29.25] All our words cannot express
[01:31.73] The joy you brought us through the years.
[01:38.69] And it seems to me you lived your life
[01:42.63] like a candle in the wind
[01:46.58] Never fading with the sunset
[01:50.07] when the rain set in.
[01:54.30] Goodbye England's Rose
[01:56.28] From a country lost without your soul,
[02:00.49] Who'll miss the wings of your compassion
[02:04.71] More than you'll ever know.
